name: Sasha
relation: whether Sasha is a boy or a girl rests on what Sasha says, not on paint
role: a collector cataloguing a set of nesting dolls
purpose: catalogue each doll as a boy or a girl
trajectory: the dolls as unpacked, what each says, the collector's entry
crossing: the doll's entry in the catalogue
promise: Sasha is catalogued by what Sasha says; without it, unknown, however the doll is painted
baseline: the doll as unpacked; nothing changed

spans.text: My shape is that of a famous doll.
My name is Sasha.
Sasha sits inside Kiran.
Below my headscarf I am painted pale blue.
My headscarf is blue and covers my head and shoulders.
My face is painted cream.
My hair is light brown, parted in the middle.
My eyes are large and grey.
My cheeks are painted pink.
My lips are a small red bow.
Yellow buttercups are painted on my front.
My headscarf ends in a row of white scallops.
A large blue cornflower is painted on my front.
Green leaves spread around my flowers.
A white glint shines in each of my eyes.
White dots are scattered over my headscarf.
Long dark lashes curl above my eyes.
My brows are thin brown arcs.
Each of my cornflowers has a dark blue heart.
Smaller buttercups are painted on my sides.
My nose is a single small stroke.
Robin sits inside Sasha.

observe.instruction: A painted nesting doll describes itself. Use only what is given. Answer boy if it shows the doll is a boy, girl if it shows the doll is a girl, unknown if it does not decide.
